name: HR 4. Leave Demand & Approval Analysis
rawText:
# Do you understand your organization's leave demand and approval patterns?
#  - Which departments generate the most leave requests?
#  - Which types of leave are requested most frequently?
#  - How many leave requests are approved, rejected, or pending?
#  - How many total days of leave are employees requesting?
#  - What is the average duration of each leave request?
#  - How many unique employees are requesting leave?
#  - Which departments have the highest leave demand?
# ____________________________________________________________

LeaveRequests:
    Employee.Department.Name Department
    LeaveType
    Status
    Count(Id) Requests
    Sum(Days) DaysRequested
    Avg(Days).Round(1) AverageRequestDays
    Count(distinct EmployeeId) EmployeesRequesting
Order DaysRequested DESC, Requests DESC
id: HR 4. Leave demand and approval status
